title: Nashville Tower | 2 miles to BDWY
description:
This New spacious  2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom house is the perfect place to relax and unwind after a day of exploring Nashville. Located just 2 miles from the heart of Broadway, you'll be close to all the action.

The house features a fully equipped kitchen, a cozy living room, and a private rooftop patio. You'll also find an arcade machine and a skee-ball game for some fun downtime. This Airbnb will ensure you never have a dull moment in Nashville!

The space
On the main floor, you will find an open concept floor plan with the kitchen and living room next to each other. On the main floor there is also a private half bath & a dedicated laundry Room. 

On the second floor, you will find Bedroom 1. Equipped with a King bed, A Futon, Smart Tv, Walk in closet with a Pack N Play and a private bathroom. 

On the third floor, you will find Bedroom 2. Equipped with a Queen Bed, 2 Full Beds ( Bunk Bed ) a smart tv, walk in closet and a private bathroom. 

On the 4th and final floor, you will access to your own private roof top patio, and an arcade machine; making this a great place to hang out and catch up with your guests.

Guest access
You'll have full access to the entire unit! All levels and the patio are open to to you, but please be aware that parking is limited and first come first serve.

Other things to note
Location Perk: Near Downtown & Major Routes
This newly remodeled building is conveniently located near a major freeway, making it super easy to get around town and explore all that Nashville has to offer. Please note that due to its central location, some traffic noise may be heard, especially during peak hours.
